function: GDM-enhanced MADDPG for UAV task offloading (GER selection, offloading ratio, computing resource allocation) with Hungarian area selection; excluded as above_phy: edge-computing decisions, not radio control (pp. 7, 10).
notes: Exclude, reason above_phy. p. 10: "Aui = {mu,j (ti ), pu,j (ti )}, where mu,j (ti ) represents the offloading GER of UAV u ... and pu,j (ti ) represents the offloading ratio"; p. 7: "the task assignment decisions for the UAV, including computation resource allocation, task offloading ratio, and GER selection, are determined through ... HG-MADDPG". The aerial-link exception does not apply: P1 optimizes computing resources, offloading and trajectory (p. 6), while transmit power Pu and bandwidth Bw are fixed parameters of the rate (8) (p. 5; Table III, p. 12); exploration areas come from the Hungarian algorithm (pp. 9-10). A learned component exists (diffusion actor in MADDPG), so no_learning does not apply; research article with simulation results (pp. 12-15).
